Lockpicks-11

Support This Game

Originally made in 72h for Ludum Dare 57 with the theme "Depths"(although we were thoroughly inspired by the controversial contender "doors"), with everything from sfx, music, art, and programming, all recorded, edited, drawn, and/or typed by our two-person team.


You've been thrown into the depths of a heist.

Help our thief prove they're not out of their depth when it comes to lockpicking their way to freedom. To what length will our burglar go to nab a precious prize from the depths of the treasure vaults? How many doors deep did they land themselves this time? Did our pilferer even consider the depth of trouble they'd be in if caught in the act? All qualms aside, I guess they're knee-deep in it now!

Puzzle your way through the collection of lockpicking minigames that stand between you and a heist well done.


If you're out of your depth, here's a puzzle guide. It contains spoilers, you've been warned.

Guide to each type of lock if anybody is really stuck (I would recommend trying to solve them yourself first):

Music note door: Plays a pattern, visual cues as well, repeat the pattern

Wooden door, bronze lock: click on tiles to reveal them, find pairs of icons

Electronic: Look for fingerprints, code is only the numbers with fingerprints on, there are two of the number where the fingerprint is smudged

Rotation lock: Buttons rotate each loop, make it so the symbols on the left are adjacent then click enter

Wooden door, stone archway, visible hinges: sticky note gives hint to four letter word, each letter links to number on phone, enter that code and hit enter

Metal Gate: It says what to do in the thing, basically just click all things which the category above applys to

Fishing door: Click buttons to raise region, keep ball in region for long enough, don't have to worry about decreasing

Bomb on door: Basically just wordle, orange is not in word, yellow in word but wrong place, green is right please

Fully rock with symbols: Each rock moves bar along a certain amount, click multiple to get it to the line

Wooden door, stone archway, can't see hinges: each button moves player in speciic direction, but is randomised, collect all diamonds

Wooden door, no specific features: Sudoku, no numbers same column, row or box

Police Car: Randomised one of any of them above
